description: These vectors were produced by the pqbind code itself: the ignored test regenerate_vectors in crates/pqbind/tests/known_answers.rs prints this file. They are not independent test vectors. Ed25519 and ML-DSA-87 signing are deterministic, identities come from the seeds, and the TLS exporter value is fixed, so every value is reproducible. They pin the wire format against accidental change, and an independent implementation can check itself against the exact bytes this one produces. All binary values are lowercase hex.
layout: transcript = role label (client: pqbind/proof/client/v1 then a zero byte; server: the same with server) | u8 length, application label | u16 length, client id | u16 length, server id | client pin (48) | server pin (48) | exporter (64). signed bytes = hybrid label | SHA-512(transcript). proof = hybrid signature of the transcript. Lengths are big-endian. HELLO = 0x01 | client public key (2626) | client proof (4693). SERVER_PROOF = 0x02 | server public key (2626) | server proof (4693). REFUSED = 0x03. On a stream every frame is preceded by its length as four big-endian bytes.
